question: How many commercial ship crossings of the Strait of Hormuz will be recorded on 12 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Hormuz.now daily totals 20 Oct-1 Nov: 7,11,6,9,6,4,8,5,6,11,13,12,9 (mean ~8, mild uptrend). Status quo (restricted) most likely through 12 Nov, giving ~4-13. Iran-Qatar 2-day reopening plan exists but conditions are heavy and the US hasn't responded; Israel reportedly wants post-midterm strikes, a tanker was hit 1 Nov. Mixture: ~75% status quo, ~10% escalation (0-5), ~15% reopening in effect by 12 Nov (June interlude ran 17-35/day, possibly higher with ~470 ships queued). Markets: only near-miss Manifold contracts (Hormuz normal by Jul 2027 at 0.47; BTC-vs-Hormuz), not anchors; no matching Polymarket/Kalshi market found.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs used identical CSV data (4-13/day, median 8) and agree on the status-quo core; they differ only in right-tail width (p90 16-22). Judgment: reopening probability by 12 Nov ~13%, escalation ~12%; the mixture puts p90 near the bottom of the reopening regime (~17). No retrieval this run.
